name: directory
fault_schedule: proof/directory/case.json: conditional creation, simultaneous replacements, stale readiness, HTTP response loss before/after PUT, no ABA, oversized read and deadline.
assertions: Exactly one concurrent conditional reservation succeeds.
Lost committed PUT response reconciles exact transition; before-write failure stays unknown.
Repeated owner labels produce fresh generation/transition and old ETag cannot overwrite.
Read validates immutable prefix, size and caller deadline.
Scoped pinned MinIO resources are cleaned.
limitations: S3-compatible local emulator only, not real AWS.
Recorded ownership intentions only: no controller/election, engine admission, safe handover or Resolver authority.
Reservation consumption is local memory; restarting processes require fresh incarnations and reservations.
